title: Robichaux band at the Old Lyric Theatre and Red Happy's departure
summary: Frazier names the members of John Robichaux's band at the Lyric, the vaudeville repertoire, and says Red Happy left for Chicago.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Oh yeah, was that with the Robichaux band?
John Robichaux's band at the Old Lyric Theatre.
You remember who else was in that band at that time?

It was, so far I can remember it was John Robichaux was the violin and the leader. They had a lady by the name of Miss Kimmel and her husband was a trumpet player. And I think, let's see, it was Alphonse Picou playing the clarinet. No, it was old man Charlie McCurtis.
I think it was old man Kimmel on the bass violin. Oh, Henry Kimmel. Henry Kimmel. Well, all regular numbers from the, during the show days. I couldn't think of all of them by the name at present.
But it was, let's see, the shows used to come in once a week.

Like some shows, it was last two weeks, some of them last one of the vaultables. They played all for the vaultables. They played all for the vaultables shows. And then they had, I think it was, let's see, some of them, I know they use high society a lot. Oh yeah, yeah. They use for the overture. Yeah. High society. High society. Yeah. Because Pickle would make with that tune. Yeah. That was Pickle's tune. Yeah. They had a fellow by the name of, he's a trombone player by the name of, that man's name again,

Oh, Johnny Lindsay. Johnny Lindsay, yeah. Johnny Lindsay, the trombone player, yeah. He was playing the trombone. Where did Red Happy go after that band? Do you remember where he went? Let me see. Red Happy stood a good while with the lyric, with the John Robichoux band. I'm not mistaken. I believe he went from the band.
He went from the band. Yeah. He went from the band. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. And after he left the band, he went to Chicago. Chicago. Illinois. Yeah. He went to Chicago, and he stood up there a good while. I believe till he died.
I believe he used to sing vocals in that with the band.
